evals.prompt: Queue the smoke suite on the hub for branch main.
evals.expected_output: Uses rfhub_queue with project+branch+suiteIds; polls rfhub_batch; does not treat array order as run order.
assertions: Uses or plans rfhub_queue with project, branch, and a suite/work selection
Requires gitSha (git rev-parse HEAD) for commit-bound evidence
Plans to poll rfhub_batch with the returned handle
Does not treat suiteIds array order as a run order

evals.prompt: Mark checkout as wip without committing Test Tags and queue that tag.
evals.expected_output: rfhub_tag_set kind suite (not each test) then rfhub_queue with tag; does not use --include wip.
assertions: Uses rfhub_tag_set with kind: suite (not kind: test)
Queues with tag: wip rather than Robot --include wip
Does not require editing Test Tags in the .robot file for the wip mark

evals.prompt: The Wave2 batch handle finished with two failed leaves. Join a rerun into that same run.
evals.expected_output: Uses rfhub_rerun with the same handle; reads units/overlay; polls rfhub_batch; does not open a new rfhub_queue to join.
assertions: Uses rfhub_rerun with the same runId/handle
Reads the echoed units / overlay parts before assuming what runs
Polls the same handle with rfhub_batch
Does not open a new rfhub_queue to join the results

evals.prompt: Queue the smoke wave on the hub for branch main in the dev environment.
evals.expected_output: Uses rfhub_queue with wave slug + environment (no long tag/suite list); notes the environment selects the orchestrator and applies its excludeTags; polls rfhub_batch.
assertions: Uses or plans rfhub_queue with wave: "smoke" (a slug), not a long list of included suites/tags
Selects environment: "dev"
Explains the environment selects the orchestrator and applies that environment's excludeTags
Requires gitSha (git rev-parse HEAD) for commit-bound evidence
Plans to poll rfhub_batch with the returned handle

evals.prompt: These suites must not run in parallel because they share a fixture. Queue the Wave1 run serially.
evals.expected_output: Uses rfhub_queue with parallelism: serial (batch capped to one executor) rather than suite/testcase; does not fake serialization by hand-picking suiteIds order.
assertions: Uses or plans rfhub_queue with parallelism: "serial"
Explains serial caps the batch to one executor / one unit at a time
Does not fake serialization by ordering suiteIds (array order is not a run order)
Does not split the run into multiple queue calls to serialize

evals.prompt: Run acceptance for this commit on branch main in accpt, then give me the report id for the release notes.
evals.expected_output: Plans rfhub_acceptance_run with project+branch+environment+gitSha; states groupId polling until merged and reading report.verdict; asks only for genuinely missing identifiers.
assertions: Names rfhub_acceptance_run and states all four required inputs (project, branch, environment, gitSha)
States polling with groupId until status is merged
States reading report.verdict (passed/failed) as the criteria outcome and quoting the report id
Does not hand-pick waves — the acceptance definition supplies the ordered waves
